changelog: FIX: VOD/series resume persistence is now wired end-to-end (periodic position updates + final save on every player exit path).
FIX: Series playback now carries full episode context into PlayerViewModel so watch history and resume rows save correctly.
FIX: Guide now maps Firestick MENU button to per-channel recording options (watch now, record now, record current, schedule next).
FIX: Home navigation actions now use debounced safe navigation to prevent duplicate-press crashes between Live/Movies/Series/Home transitions.
IMPROVEMENT: Channel zapping debounce reduced for faster switching without VLC teardown races.
IMPROVEMENT: DVR recording paths now disable frame skipping to improve long-session A/V continuity.
